title: Mayor Todd Gloria and Local Students Plant Trees for Kate Sessions Day
description: SAN DIEGO – Join Mayor Todd Gloria, City Councilmember Henry Foster III, City staff and local students from Oak Park Elementary School today for a tree planting event at Oak Park Neighborhood Park. This community event is part of Ready, Set, Grow San Diego, a project of the City of San Diego’s Urban Forestry Program, which was awarded a $10 million grant from the U.S. Forest Service, an agency of the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA), for a five-year tree planting program.
